notes: Kit consists of two separate desktop (non-rackmount) units: Transmitter AC-EX100-444-T3 and Receiver AC-EX100-444-R3, linked over a single Cat6A cable via HDBaseT (RJ45, PoH). Only one 48V/0.5A power supply is included; PoH powers the other unit, so only one of the two 48V terminal-block inputs is normally used at a time (both are listed as physical ports below). HDMI ports are HDMI 2.0/HDCP 2.3 (18Gbps max, 10.2Gbps in ICT compression mode) - graded hdmi-2.0. Ethernet passthrough ports are 10/100 (eth-100m) per the official manual's technical specification table, despite marketing copy elsewhere describing "up to 1Gbps" Ethernet extension - the panel-diagram/spec-table numbers were treated as authoritative. HDBaseT RJ45 link ports are proprietary long-range extension links (not standard Ethernet data ports) so no eth-* grade was applied. USB ports are all USB 2.0 (390Mbps enhanced spec per marketing, 350Mbps per manual) - graded usb-2.0; USB1/USB2 Type-A ports and the Type-B "USB HOST DEVICE (PC)" port are role-selectable (host/device) per unit, so all are marked bidirectional. The USB-C "USB ISP" port is a proprietary firmware/service port for AVPro Edge technical support, not a standard host/data port, so left ungraded. IR EYE and I-PASS are both 3.5mm stereo (TRS) IR receiver inputs; IR OUT is 3.5mm mono (TS) IR transmitter output (all mapped to trs-3.5, closest allowed connector). The 48V power input is a 2-pin terminal block (not a barrel jack); mapped to euroblock-dc as the closest connector in the allowed list. RS-232 is a 3-pin terminal block, mapped to euroblock. TOSLINK ports carry extracted stereo/multichannel PCM/Dolby audio only.
